To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
COSMOS enables mobile computation offloading to cloud resources with high efficiency.

(a) the COSMOS design choices of (1) leasing cloud resources for short time quanta and (2) allocating resources to offloading requests in a risk-controlled and contention-aware manner can significantly reduce the cost of providing computation offloading service to mobile devices, (b) COSMOS can effectively schedule offloading requests to cloud resources, and (c) COSMOS has great potential in reducing the monetary cost per offloading request and in improving the offloading performance seen at mobile devices
COSMOS is a system that can provide computation offloading as an efficient, risk-controlled, and cost-effective service for mobile devices.

the design space of mobile cloud computing is large, and the design of mobile cloud computing systems should be carefully considered to achieve both performance and economic benefits.
